heroSummary: Students in Weber School District start Monday, August 24, 2026, and the entire opening week follows an early-out schedule. Every instructional Wednesday is also an early-out day, with elementary schools dismissing at 12:20 p.m. and secondary schools at 1:15 p.m. Secondary students follow the A/B rotation printed on the district calendar. The school year ends Friday, May 28, 2027.
calendarNotes: Weber schedules teacher contract days August 18–19 and professional development August 20–21 before students begin August 24. August 24–28 are early-out days, and every instructional Wednesday is also early out at 12:20 for elementary and 1:15 for secondary students. The daily A/B letters in the grid identify the secondary rotation and do not represent closures. Elementary parent-teacher conferences are October 12–13 and February 8–9 with 1:20 early out, while secondary conferences are September 30 and February 24. Compensation days November 25, February 12, and March 26 keep students out; the March date sits immediately before Spring Break. WSD lists 180 student days for the year: 43, 43, 49, and 45 by quarter. The PDF's holiday legend says February 16 for the federal holiday, but its grid marks Monday, February 15 as no school and Tuesday, February 16 as a B day and mid-term. The federal 2027 holiday calendar also places Washington’s Birthday on February 15.

customSections.label: Why This Page Uses February 15 for the Federal Holiday
customSections.content: WSD’s calendar legend lists February 16 as a federal holiday, but the date grid marks Monday, February 15 as the no-school day and shows February 16 as an instructional B day and mid-term. The federal 2027 holiday calendar also places Washington’s Birthday on February 15. For that reason, this page lists February 15 as the no-school federal holiday and preserves February 16 as the mid-term/B day shown in WSD’s grid. We note the mismatch here so you can see why February 15 is listed.

customSections.label: Quarter Dates and the 180-Day School Year
customSections.content: WSD lists 180 student days for 2026–27: 43 days in the first quarter, 43 in the second, 49 in the third, and 45 in the fourth.

groups.label: Changes families may notice from the 2025–26 calendar
items: The first day moves from August 19 to August 24, and the last day moves from May 22 to May 28.
Secondary Wednesday early out changes from 1:20 to 1:15; elementary remains 12:20.
Quarter lengths change from 47, 44, 49, and 40 days to 43, 43, 49, and 45 days, while the school year remains 180 days.
Spring Break moves to March 29–April 2, with a March 26 compensation day immediately before it.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Weber School District start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students begin Monday, August 24, 2026. August 24–28 all use early-out schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Weber Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 29–April 2, 2027. Students are also off Friday, March 26, immediately before Spring Break.

calendarFaqs.q: What time is Wednesday early out in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists 12:20 for elementary schools and 1:15 for secondary schools on every instructional Wednesday.

calendarFaqs.q: Is Weber closed February 15 or February 16, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The WSD grid marks Monday, February 15 as the no-school federal holiday and shows Tuesday, February 16 as an instructional B day and mid-term. The PDF legend says February 16, but the federal 2027 holiday calendar also places Washington’s Birthday on February 15.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in Weber's 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The four official quarter counts total 180 days: 43, 43, 49, and 45.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Weber school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Friday, May 28, 2027, with early out.
